ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels, with white covering approximately 80-85% of the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central region; solid black contiguous banding along the entire trailing edge and both distal tips; sparse, isolated dark pixel clusters (mottling) on the lower right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 85-90 degrees and moderate depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; irregular jagged profile with deeper indentations on the left lobe compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the outer margins leading to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of high-intensity circular pixel nodes on the dorsal/lateral aspect of the left tip; several small dark-intensity focal points on the white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization on the left fluke tip; irregular mechanical-type notches on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel occlusion at the fluke base and lower left lobe due to high-intensity water spray and turbulence.
